_note: The four web routes without an AuthGuard (/commerce-login, /commerce/join, /commerce/connect, /commerce/connect/privacy) live in the (public) route group, like the other public sign-in routes (/maxina, /delete-account, /profile/[id]): under (app) the AuthGate would bounce a signed-out supplier to the community /maxina sign-in, which the web deliberately does not do (VTID-03894). The lane file names apps/mobile/app/(app)/commerce-login.tsx; Lane scope flags the (public) paths — noted in the PR body. No shell, identity or ORB file is changed.
